evidence.note: Paraphrase of the cited source: National Olympiad in Informatics in Provinces, a Chinese secondary-student programming competition within the NOI pathway. Eligibility: Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, and Macao secondary students qualify under CCF NOIP rules and provincial selection. Format: A national programming examination, historically held over one or two contest days depending on rules.
